## Summary

Zephyr Point Media Ltd (policy CC-1481): theft from a locked van of a 3D printer and filament stock at a shared workshop on Tanner Row. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 6,264 dollars. Two file gaps are noted under Coverage analysis and Reserve.

## Facts

Zephyr Point Media Ltd reported the loss on 20 April 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss was theft from a locked van at a shared workshop on Tanner Row [notice of loss], [police report]. The items are a 3D printer and filament stock [notice of loss], [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 22 April 2026 under reference CR/2026/4169 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The file does not state the date of the theft [notice of loss], [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the scheduled premises, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy]. The items are business contents, and the cause of loss is theft [notice of loss], [police report]. The policy schedule is not in the file, so the named premises cannot be checked against it. The file also does not say in terms that the van was in the insured's custody. Both points should be confirmed.

- **Exclusion 7.1 (unattended property)** does not apply. It excludes theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared space unless it was in a locked container or locked room. The workshop is shared [notice of loss], but the items were in a locked container [police report], [policy].
- **Exclusion 7.3 (wear and tear)** does not apply. It concerns gradual deterioration, and the loss is theft [notice of loss], [policy].
- **Exclusion 7.5 (unproven loss)** is not engaged on the file as it stands. It excludes a loss not reported to the police within seven days where theft is alleged [policy]. The police report is dated 22 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss of 20 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss]. The date of the theft is not in the file, so the seven-day period cannot be measured from it. The date of loss should be confirmed to close this point.

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to the premises, custody and date-of-loss points above.

## Reserve

The reserve is 6,264 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (5,181 dollars and 1,083 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. Clause 9.1 deducts the 250-dollar excess only where the policy schedule applies one, and applies none where the schedule shows none [policy]. The schedule is not in the file, so no excess is shown and none is deducted. If the schedule applies the excess, the reserve becomes 6,014 dollars.
